title: Soldier Hydration Drill Animator
description: A soldier performs a looping march animation on a training field. The user controls a multi-step hydration drill sequence: positioning a water bottle at a supply station, triggering the soldier to walk toward it, blending from walk to idle, playing a custom drink animation via morph/rotation, adjusting playback speed, reversing the sequence, and resetting the drill. A HUD displays the current animation state, blend weight, and step count.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load soldier.glb and WaterBottle.glb. Scene setup: a flat green ground plane, soft directional light plus ambient light, camera at (0,2,5) looking at origin. Place the soldier at (-4,0,0) facing +X and the water bottle at (4,0,0.8) scaled to 5x on a small brown box pedestal. The soldier model contains skeletal animations; extract all clip actions via AnimationMixer. Requirements: (1) A 'Start March' button plays the soldier walk animation and translates the soldier toward the bottle over 3 seconds using a tween or manual lerp in the render loop. (2) When the soldier reaches x>3, auto-crossfade from walk to idle animation over 0.5s using crossFadeTo. (3) A 'Drink' button becomes enabled; clicking it rotates the water bottle smoothly to tilt 45 degrees on X and translates it to the soldier's hand position (approximate offset from soldier root). (4) A speed slider (0.25x to 3x) adjusts the AnimationMixer timeScale in real time. (5) A 'Reverse' button sets all active actions to play backward by negating timeScale, making the soldier walk back and the bottle return. (6) A 'Reset Drill' button stops all actions, resets soldier position to start, resets bottle orientation and position, and re-disables the Drink button. (7) Display a HUD overlay showing current state name, blend weight of active clips rounded to 2 decimals, mixer time, and a step counter that increments with each button press. Validate that Drink cannot be clicked before the soldier arrives, Reverse cannot be clicked before Drink, and Reset is always available. Use requestAnimationFrame loop updating mixer with clock delta. All UI as HTML overlay elements with pointer-events.
